title: YouTube CEO Neal Mohan publishes his annual letter, saying the platform wants to fight "AI slop" and strengthen parental tools, and teases Shorts updates (Alex Weprin/The Hollywood Reporter)
summary: Alex Weprin / The Hollywood Reporter: YouTube CEO Neal Mohan publishes his annual letter, saying the platform wants to fight “AI slop” and strengthen parental tools, and teases Shorts updates — The executive published his annual letter to the YouTube community Wednesday, outlining his priorities for the video platform.
